title: See a command's output on screen and also save it to a file
summary: Run a command, show its output on the screen as it happens, and write a copy into a file at the same time. Useful for keeping a log of a build or a long install that you still want to watch.

aliases.text: save output to file and show on screen
log command output to file and terminal
keep a copy of terminal output
write output to file and display
сохранить вывод в файл и показать на экране
записать вывод команды в файл linux

steps.explain: Run COMMAND and join its errors to its normal output (2>&1). tee shows everything on screen and writes the same text to LOG_FILE. An existing LOG_FILE is replaced.
steps.expect: The usual output of the command appears on screen, and LOG_FILE receives the same text.

placeholders.name: LOG_FILE
placeholders.description: File to save the copy in

alternatives.explain: Add to the end of an existing LOG_FILE instead of replacing it. -a means append.

steps.explain: Look at the end of the saved file to check that it holds the output.
steps.expect: The last lines of the same output you saw on screen.
